Samir (SE): Heads-up — Helios asked about swapping from CompetitorX to Redwood for their chat endpoint. They want a POC next week. Main asks: prompt parity, token billing differences, and security questionnaire returned today.

Natalie (AE): Thanks. Who's owning the POC coord? I can drive engagement with their engineering/product. Need pricing band answers for dedicated vs hosted numbers.

Samir (SE): I'll own the tech side. Natalie — can you share the example prompts they care about? They mentioned multi-turn dialogs with stateful conversation + tool calls.

Diego (Solutions): We should confirm their existing request/response shape. CompetitorX returns: {"choices":[{"text":"...","metadata":{}}]} vs our chunked streaming format. They'll need a thin compatibility shim unless they update client.

Zhen (Eng): Quick note: model parity isn't 1:1. CompetitorX uses internal post-processing that normalizes greetings and truncates at sentence boundaries. We should capture a few golden prompts and run diff-based evals for semantic parity.

Marco (SRE): Security questionnaire — shared answers are in the doc. @sec-qa-bot already flagged 3 items: KMS for customer keys, audit log retention SLA, and network egress IPs for their allowlist.

sec-qa-bot: Automated scan complete — outstanding items: "HSM/KMS integration" (REQ-12), "SOC2 artifacts" (REQ-4), "IP allowlist stability" (REQ-7). See /internal/security/helios-qna link.

Natalie (AE): Helios needs a clear migration story for zero-downtime switchover. They also asked about token billing reconciliation — they bill customers per response token and want to map 1:1 for invoicing.

Samir (SE): For token deltas we should run a small corpus. Action: Diego to extract 200 representative user threads from their sample dataset (anonymized), run both systems, produce token counts and response diffs.

Diego (Solutions): Will do. ETA EOD tomorrow. Will also include edge cases they flagged: long context (>8k tokens), streaming cancels, and multi-tool call state.

Zhen (Eng): I'll set up an automated eval job: run their samples against our candidate model and CompetitorX, produce per-utterance similarity and a small human review queue for any >15% semantic delta. Also add a prompt template mapping table — notable differences: default stop sequences, top_p vs nucleus, and presence/absence of repetition penalty.

Samir (SE): For the lightweight compat shim, propose two routes: 1) proxy that rewrites competitor requests to Redwood API (quick, keeps client unchanged) 2) ask them to change client to Redwood SDK (longer, cleaner). We'll draft both timelines/costs.

Natalie (AE): Pricing question from Helios: they want a ballpark for 500k tokens/month hosted vs dedicated reserved. Can someone send a conservative estimate I can include in the commercial?

Marco (SRE): Dedicated estimate depends on model size and QPS. I'll send a calc: baseline GPU ops estimate + 20% buffer for burst. Posting calc in minutes.

Samir (SE): Also logging: they'll need redaction rules before we ingest their corpus. Diego, please confirm anonymization steps.

Diego (Solutions): We'll hash PII fields and strip attachments. Will provide a short script.

Natalie (AE): Customer asked for a 2-week POC window with success criteria: 1) <=10% user-visible delta on NPS-like prompts, 2) within 5% token billing variance, 3) no security blockers in questionnaire.

Zhen (Eng): Agree. We'll map acceptance tests to those criteria. Suggest a smoke checklist:
```
- proxy shim up and responding to sample requests
- 200 sample comparisons run and diffs uploaded
- streaming/cancel smoke passed
- KMS integration plan documented
- IP allowlist and audit log retention confirmed
```

Samir (SE): I'm going to draft the technical presales email summarizing steps, POC scope, and timeline. Will include: proxy instructions, eval harness, checklist, security answers, and pricing ranges.

Marco (SRE): FYI — if we open a temporary dedicated pool for them, we need legal signoff for interim SLA. CCing infra-policy.

Natalie (AE): Great. I'll sync with the Helios PM and propose kickoff Tues 10am PT. If we get buy-in this week we can start data handoff Mon.

Diego (Solutions): Uploading anonymization script to the shared drive now. Link: drive.redwood.co/helios-anon (internal).

Samir (SE): Next actions summary:
- Natalie: confirm kickoff with Helios and get sample prompts/corpus
- Diego: run sample extract + anonymize + run both systems by EOD tomorrow
- Zhen: create eval job and mapping table
- Marco: sizing calc + IP list
- Samir: draft presales email and compat shim options

Natalie (AE): ✅ I'll follow up with Helios and drop meeting invite. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Zhen (Eng): Adding a PR for the eval harness and will post link here once done.

Samir (SE): If any blockers pop up (esp. security questionnaire items), flag immediately. Otherwise we'll reconvene after Diego's run.

Natalie (AE): thanks all.
